jobs.title: Head of Engineering (m/f/d)
jobs.jd:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You lead engineering at ecoplanet: 11 engineers in two squads, including two squad leads.

This is the most senior engineering role in the company. There is no CTO above you. You own the technical direction, not just the delivery of someone else's plan, and you are the engineering voice on the leadership team.

It is also a hands-on job. With a team this size you stay close to the code and the architecture. If you have been away from technical work for a few years, this might not be the right role for you.

What you will own:

  • The team. 11 engineers, which includes two engineering managers. Hiring, performance, growth, and keeping good people
  • The systems. Our Cockpit SaaS platform, the metering and IoT integration layer, the data platform (time-series ingestion, quality, pipelines), the forecasting and optimization services, and the automation that acts on customer assets
  • The technical direction. Architecture, build-vs-buy, and the big platform calls
  • Delivery. Quarterly roadmap execution, owned together with Product
  • Operations. Reliability, on-call, incidents, security posture, and cloud spend


What You’ll Achieve

  • Get the best out of the team you have and grow only where it clearly adds. At 11 people, losing one strong engineer costs more than one extra hire gains. But you should be capable of growing the team substantially if business demands it
  • Turn the roadmap into commitments the company can count on.

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. jobs.jd:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.


Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du prüfst die Belege und Buchungsdaten unserer Mandanten, klärst Unstimmigkeiten direkt mit ihnen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Steuer-Team auf einer sauberen Datenbasis arbeitet.

Dazu arbeitest du Hand in Hand mit unserer KI: Du kontrollierst, was sie vorschlägt, übernimmst die Fälle, an die sie noch nicht herankommt, und entwickelst sie mit jedem Fall weiter.<

At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.

We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.
